B:common_stock:oversell.message: The Account holds 300 and cannot sell 500; going short needs a securities borrow. Terminal: "Sells from Long NFTW in this Account, which is long 300 at an average 50.357. 500 is more than it holds."

B:etf:sell-more-than-the-position.message: The position chosen on the ticket holds 150. The other 250 are a different position and are not sold by this ticket. Terminal: "Sells from Long MTMK in this Account, which is long 150 at an average 99.48. 200 is more than it holds."

B:etn:issuer-redemption-not-automated.message: An issuer redemption or credit-event settlement of an ETN is not simulated. It is recorded by hand as a sale at a stated price. Terminal: "The Lifecycle menu of this position offers only: Manual cash flow. "Early redemption" is not offered."

B:short_sale:register-a-short-sale.message: A short sale is not an instrument. It is the Sell short action on the security, with its borrow leg. Terminal: "A short sale is placed from the trade ticket of the security itself (Sell short), always with its securities borrow leg. Register the security, not the sale."

B:short_sale:short-without-borrow-data.message: No borrow availability or fee is supplied for CWFL and none was stated: a short sale cannot proceed without a securities borrow. Terminal: "Leg 1: no borrow availability data for CWFL. None is supplied for this instrument. State a borrow assumption (availability and fee) to proceed."

B:short_sale:buy-with-restricted-cash.message: Short-sale proceeds and the margin reserve are not buying power. Terminal: "Alpha is short 28,796.40 USD: the package needs 500,125.00 USD (purchases 500,100.00 USD, fees 25.00 USD, margin and collateral 0.00 USD, reserved 0.00 USD) and 471,328.60 USD is available. Add Treasury funding or a borrowing leg, convert currency, or reduce the size."

B:short_sale:withdraw-restricted-cash.message: Restricted collateral and the margin reserve cannot leave the Account. Terminal: "Alpha has 471,328.60 USD of settled USD available; 480,000.00 USD requested."
